scope.candidate_denominator: logged candidates after duplicate/already-observed filtering; includes cache lookups
scope.runtime: logged extra mode planning after old scheduler; not complete decision CPU or exclusive CPU time
scope.route_gap: finite frozen additive mode model only; never original Q3 optimality gap
scope.cost: actual first-probe-through-same-source-clear cost less first arrival; also normalized to entry switch=1
scope.exit: distance from frozen mean exit representative to actual clear endpoint; no posterior coverage claim
scope.selection_bias: only actually selected executed completed local services calibrated; not causal or all-mode accuracy

center_atom_diagnostic.interpretation: deterministic finite quadrature atom, not a calibrated event probability; selected services are dependent and not a Bernoulli significance test
